description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Under Section 66 (C) Notice on Summon meeting to fill the vacancy of the keralaipattu west Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: The gazette content is a notice summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Chairman of a Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority). This action is taken under the specific authority of the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. The core subject is the electoral process for a local government body, which fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters related to electoral processes, candidate nominations, and filling vacancies.
